text:
zoe-peopleops: Quick question from Kevin's team  Kevin submitted an off-cycle title change + comp adjustment for Harpreet, asking for effective 2026-04-01 with a backpay to 2026-03-01. Can payroll accommodate?

kevin-eng: Yes, title SWE II -> SWE III, salary 118000 -> 130000, want backpay to 3/1. Manager evidence + org lead signoff in /hr/promos/harpreet/.

paul-payroll: Cutoff reminder: monthly run closes on the 20th 23:59 UTC. If you submit before that we can include the change in the next run with retro to 3/1; otherwise it'll be a separate correction on the subsequent run. Corrections tax-adjust and show as an adjustment line.

zoe-peopleops: Also note: title change may require comp calibration confirmation for equity banding. Talia, can you advise?

talia-talent: For band bump we need a short leveling note + the calibration snapshot. We can approve the salary change prior to committee but equity sizing will follow. Typically 1-2 business days.

kevin-eng: We prefer correction so Harpreet gets cash sooner. Any required forms?

forms-bot: Submit retro form here: https://internal.forms/retro-change. Use code: RETRO-EXPEDITE. Attach manager rationale and org signoff.

paul-payroll: Once form ID is posted here I'll create payroll ticket and flag as "expedite retro". Note: if the effective date changes cross-quarter, finance will need to reconcile YTD.

kevin-eng: Rationale: "Promotion for sustained ownership of payment-routing reliability and mentoring across services." Form submitted ID RETRO-2409.

paul-payroll: Got RETRO-2409. Created ticket PAY-2026-598 (expedite). Expect processing in 2 business days; will upload tracker to the shared folder.

talia-talent: Pinged comp committee for band confirmation. No blocker for salary. Equity to be deferred to next grant window per manager.

zoe-peopleops: Action list recap: Kevin -> evidence (done), Paul -> payroll ticket (done), Talia -> comp confirmation (in flight). I'll update the employee record and close when payroll posts. Reopen if exceptions.
